bgm.source: marketing/_shared/music/01-introducing.wav (MP3 stream in a .wav name), transcoded to PCM as assets/bgm/track.wav. Bed = 38.43 s to 50.43 s (the drop into the loud part, about -12 dB RMS the whole way), 10 ms fade-in, 0.7 s fade-out. Cut per reel length by tools/make_bed.sh; muxed onto the rendered picture by render.sh.
